name: intitle: with an OR group, never space-separated terms
when: a query restricts to titles with more than one candidate term
shape: intitle:(<term1> OR <term2> OR "<phrase>") <context term> — space-separated terms inside intitle: are an implicit AND
ingredients: one context term outside the group
yields: title-focused pages that a space-separated intitle: stack returns empty
misses: works whose titles use none of the listed terms; OR groups over ~6 terms dilute the page
origin: gs_revamp query-craft study (2026-07-08): the space-AND class returned ~0 and vanished after the OR-group rule; the query-craft gate refuses malformed OR groups
